message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
A long weekend is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday on either a **Friday** or a **Monday** (or an observed holiday on the nearest weekday when the holiday falls on a weekend).  

| Date Range | Holiday (Observed) | Notes |
|------------|--------------------|-------|
| **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, PEI, NB, etc.) | 3rd Monday in February |
| **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday | Friday, 7 Apr |
| **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day | Monday before May 25 |
| **Jul 1 – 3** | Canada Day | Saturday 1 Jul → observed on Friday 1 Jul |
| **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day | First Monday in September |
| **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving | Second Monday in October |
| **Nov 10 – 12** | Remembrance Day | Saturday 11 Nov → observed on Friday 10 Nov |
| **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas Day | Monday 25 Dec |

### Quick Reference

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------|-------------------|
| Family Day | Feb 20 (Mon) | Feb 18‑20 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Fri) | Apr 7‑9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Mon) | May 20‑22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Sat) – observed Fri 1 | Jul 1‑3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Mon) | Sep 2‑4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 (Mon) | Oct 7‑9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Sat) – observed Fri 10 | Nov 10‑12 |
| Christmas | Dec 25 (Mon) | Dec 23‑25 |

> **Tip:** Some provinces have additional holidays that can create extra long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on March 17, 2023). If you need province‑specific calendars, let me know and I can pull those in as well.
